feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 August 2026 10:50pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 08 August 2026 at 10:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over eastern Europe and low pressure near Iceland as a waving frontal zone affects the northwest of the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, veering and decreasing West or Southwest 3 or 4 overnight. Little change then until veering North or Northwest 3 or 4 tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west at first.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain and drizzle later tonight and tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 3 or 4, falling Variable 2 or 3 later on Monday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Any remaining patchy rain and drizzle quickly clearing to become fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in any rain and drizzle at first.
